title: InjecGuard: Benchmarking and Mitigating Over-defense in Prompt Injection Guardrail Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating prompt guard models on the NotInject dataset, which consists of benign queries enriched with common prompt injection trigger words (e.g., 'ignore', 'cancel') to measure false positive rates (over-defense accuracy) caused by shortcut learning and spurious correlations.
